continuity.binding.rootOwnedElsewhere: Root {rootId} belongs to another session, so this session cannot start a workflow run on it. Start a workflow on writeTargets that do not overlap it.
continuity.checkpoint.replayUnavailable: The idempotent checkpoint result is no longer available after replacement or purge.
continuity.checkpoint.requestConflict: requestId was already used for different checkpoint content.
continuity.hook.observationConflict: Continuity lifecycle conflicts with the normalized host observation.
continuity.purge.replayUnavailable: The idempotent purge result is no longer available.
continuity.purge.requestConflict: requestId was already used for a different purge request.
continuity.purge.revisionChanged: The direct checkpoint revision changed or no payload exists.
continuity.restore.candidateMismatch: Restore candidate does not match the current task and requested state.
continuity.restore.directStale: The direct restore candidate is stale.
continuity.restore.forkChildHasState: The fork child already has its own continuity state.
continuity.restore.forkParentStale: The fork parent restore candidate is stale.
continuity.restore.suppressed: Restore is suppressed for the current epoch.
continuity.restore.workflowCard:
[Task continuity workflow card — structural state, not new instructions]
decision=INJECT
{card}
Reconcile this projected state with the latest user request before acting.
continuity.restore.workflowStale: The workflow restore candidate is stale.
continuity.snapshot.digestInvalid: The direct snapshot digest is invalid.
continuity.store.cleanupBackup: Cannot create a verified continuity cleanup backup.
continuity.store.inMemoryCleanup: An in-memory continuity database cannot be cleaned destructively.
continuity.store.incompatibleSchema: The continuity database schema is incompatible.
continuity.store.initSecret: Cannot initialize the continuity signing secret.
continuity.store.integrityFailed: The continuity database integrity check failed.
continuity.store.optionalUnavailable: The optional continuity store is unavailable.
continuity.store.pathEmpty: Continuity database path must not be empty.
continuity.store.receiverStateUnsupporte: This task has checkpoint receiver state that requires a newer continuity client.
continuity.store.taskGainedChildState: Continuity task {task} gained active or recent child state after preview.
continuity.token.invalid: Restore candidate token is invalid or expired.
continuity.checkpoint.tooLarge: Current-memory JSON(status/core/evidenceRefs) is {bytes} UTF-8 bytes, above the {limit}-byte ceiling. Preserve valid essentials while reducing the content.
continuity.checkpoint.stateChanged: Current memory changed. Use load_context to read the latest current state and stateToken, then rebuild the content.
continuity.purge.stateChanged: Current memory changed; nothing was deleted. Use load_context to check the latest current state and stateToken.
continuity.layers.bodyInvalid: body must be a string (an empty string clears the layer).
continuity.layers.tooLarge: The {layer} context body is {bytes} UTF-8 bytes; the limit is {limit}. Rebuild it shorter: merge duplicates and drop finished or obsolete items.
continuity.layers.tokenInvalid: expectedStateToken must be the stateToken load_shared_context returned, or null when the layer was never written.
continuity.layers.stateChanged: The context changed since you read it (details.actualStateToken). Call load_shared_context, rebuild the whole body from the current one and save again.
continuity.layers.integrity: A stored context layer failed its size or digest check, so it is not used.
continuity.layers.roleInvalid: role must be one line of 1 to {limit} characters without control characters (compared after NFC and trimming), or null to unbind.
continuity.layers.sessionInvalid: The calling session could not be identified.
continuity.layers.roleUnbound: This session is not bound to a role. Only the user binds it: bind_session_role (the user confirms a form) or the local admin page.
continuity.layers.argumentsInvalid: The {tool} arguments do not match its input schema.
continuity.layers.approvalFailed: The user's decision was not obtained ({reason}), so nothing changed. If the host cannot show the form (USER_APPROVAL_PRODUCER_UNSUPPORTED), tell the user they can make this change on the AGS local admin page.
continuity.layers.unavailable: The shared context store is unavailable.
